## Checklist

- [ ] No real financial or personal data anywhere (code, tests, fixtures, screenshots)
- [ ] No new runtime dependency, no build step
- [ ] Nothing new leaves the device or the server; or, if it does, it is minimal, anonymised, behind a privacy switch and logged
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `bash tests/run-all.sh` passes
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and docs updated if behaviour changed
